verdict.rationale: GA4's Data API documents a native batch endpoint, batchRunPivotReports, which returns multiple pivot reports in one call. That is genuine first-party bulk capability, but it covers only report retrieval. The Admin API automates reading and changing settings, but the evidence shows no batch or bulk mutation endpoints, so changing many items still means scripting individual calls. Missing for 10: documented bulk create/update/delete across many config items (custom dimensions, key events, links), batch event submission semantics, and hands-on corroboration of batch usage.
